Closes #3956

## What changed

New ruling **R3956000**, which amends R3734001. R3734001 said the editor is one column from 601 to 760 px, which contradicted its own "side by side from 601 px". The ruling note is in `spec/rulings/R3956000.md` and the §11 paragraph is in `spec/pending/3956.md`.

- **Split from 601 px.**
  - `deckbuilder.css`, `workshop.css`, `almanac.css` and `dungeon.css` now stack at 600 px and under and split from 601 px. They used to stack at 760 and split from 761, which is why 744 stacked.
  - From 601 to 760 px the sidebar is 232 px.
  - The status toast has a new block for 601 to 760 px.
- **Rail names whole.**
  - `.ws-row-name` wraps to three lines and breaks long words, with no ellipsis.
  - The rail and its rows use less padding from 601 to 1024 px, so the name column is 60 px at 744 and 76 px at 820 (it was 44 and 60).
  - A `title` on the name gives the full text on hover.
- **Title beside Back.** From 601 to 1024 px the bar's line dissolves into the bar, so Back, the title and the end group share the first row and the extras take the second.
- **Phone name field.**
  - `DeckEditor.tsx` wraps the Back label in `.ws-back-label`.
  - On a phone the editor's Back shows its arrow only, with the words kept for a screen reader.
  - The trio and import panels keep their worded Back.
- **1280×720.** The deck's minimum height drops from 360 to 200 px, so the last action row is in view and the sidebar doesn't scroll.
- **Cards tab set row.** Each set is as wide as its name and count, the name is never cut, the scrollbar is shown again, and the right edge fades out.
- `MenuShell.test.tsx` now expects six toast widths instead of five.
- Docs: one sentence each in `docs/polish/10-menus.md` and `apps/web/README.md`, and `breakpoints.ts`'s `narrow` comment.

- **Departure from the plan: bar rules by custom property.**
  - `top-bar.test.ts` forbids `.screen-nav__` in any sheet but `top-bar.css` and pins that sheet's media queries to 600 px, so the plan's `.workshop .screen-nav__line { display: contents }` failed it.

  - dropping the rail at 744;
  - a 280 px sidebar, which leaves the pool 184 px;
  - one large-card column in the pool at 744;
  - a phone title beside Back (R3218000 keeps it under Back).

  - I temporarily reverted the CSS and TSX: the 744-px side-by-side test and all five new R3956000 tests failed, and they pass with the fix.
  - Every other test in the file passed except the four whole-catalog card-fit tests, which I skipped because they take over five minutes here.
